features.title: Bounded IPP parsing, rewriting, normalization, and malformed-input rejection
The firmware and host oracle use the same request relay policy
IPP/1.1 fallback with an IPP/2.0-facing normalized facade
Advertised document formats are relayed unchanged
The production document pump handles bounded buffers and short reads/writes
Truncations, bit mutations, and deterministic random IPP messages are sanitizer-clean
Print, validate, create, send, query, list, and cancel operations relay safely
AirPrint DNS-SD TXT records are generated by host-tested production code
A published facade is discoverable with ippfind/Avahi
acceptance: Discovery exposes rp, pdl, URF, UUID, Color, Duplex, and _universal
Service name collisions remain discoverable
Stopping the service withdraws it

features.title: All applicable CUPS IPP/1.1 conformance tests pass
All applicable CUPS IPP/2.0 conformance tests pass
acceptance: Required IPP/2.0 description and job-template attributes are truthful
No unsupported operation is advertised

features.title: Chunked client request bodies stream through the ESP HTTP endpoint
acceptance: ipptool -C Print-Job succeeds
Peak buffering stays bounded independently of document size

features.title: Short reads/writes, timeouts, disconnects, and response size limits are deterministic
acceptance: Document bytes are neither duplicated nor dropped under short I/O
Non-idempotent jobs are never retried after ambiguous delivery
Timeout and size-limit failures return stable gateway errors

features.title: IPP messages and captured printer profiles survive coverage-guided fuzzing
